scope: CL-01/08 independent WFC art kit and assembled-map visualization
artDirection: Hand-inked grey-olive boulders, restrained moss, ochre walking surfaces, cool blue-green receding cavern walls; side-on view with visible shallow top faces.
production: Built-in imagegen creates reusable native sources. A deterministic game-style canvas renderer composes the sources on socket-constrained geometry and exports actual RGBA modules. Geometry, sockets and image manifests remain reproducible.

plannedSources.use: Horizontal walkable ledge with a visible top face and thick front face
plannedSources.precision: Runtime maps the shared profile; generated endpoints alone are not accepted as sockets

plannedSources.use: Hanging rock lip and downward roots
plannedSources.precision: Runtime maps the shared ceiling profile

completed.feedback: Broader uneven visible walking plane and shared whole-outline rounded transitions; no forced interpolation through sharp original corners.

boundaries: No edits to the concurrent whitebox implementation
No modification of reference or author assets
Painted atlas is a phase-zero reference; reusable assembly requires the provided world-UV and shared-contour contract
